field.description: Resets the divider counter. Can be used to make sure a new divider value is used right away rather than completing the previous count

field.name: HALT
field.description: Halts the divider counter. The intent is to allow the divider clock source to be changed without the risk of a glitch at the output

field.description: Divider status flag. Set when a change is made to the divider value, cleared when the change is complete. The clock being divided must be running for this status to change

register.name: HWWAKE
register.description: Hardware Wake-up control register. The primary use of the hardware Wake-up control register is to provide the possibility for some peripherals to have DMA service during deep-sleep mode without waking up entire device. These wake-ups are based on peripheral FIFO levels, not directly related to peripheral DMA requests and interrupts

field.name: FORCEWAKE
field.description: Force peripheral clocking to stay on during deep-sleep mode. When 1, clocking to peripherals is prevented from being shut down when the CPU enters deep-sleep mode. This is intended to allow a coprocessor to continue operating while the main CPU(s) are shut down.

field.name: FCWAKE
field.description: Wake for Flexcomm Interfaces. When 1, any Flexcomm Interface FIFO reaching the level specified by its own TXLVL will cause peripheral clocking to wake up temporarily while the related status is asserted.

field.name: DMICWAKE
field.description: Wake for Digital Microphone. When 1, the digital microphone input FIFO reaching the level specified by TRIGLVL of either channel will cause peripheral clocking to wake up temporarily while the related status is asserted.

field.name: DMAC0WAKE
field.description: Wake for DMAC0. When 1, DMAC0 being busy will cause peripheral clocking to remain running until DMAC0 completes. This is generally used in conjunction with bit 1 and/or 2 in order to prevent peripheral clocking from being shut down as soon as the cause of wake-up is cleared, but before DMAC0 has completed its related activity.

field.name: DMAC1WAKE
field.description: Wake for DMAC1. When 1, DMAC1 being busy will cause peripheral clocking to remain running until DMAC1 completes. This is generally used in conjunction with bit 1 and/or 2 in order to prevent peripheral clocking from being shut down as soon as the cause of wake-up is cleared, but before DMAC1 has completed its related activity.

field.name: STOP_REQ
field.description: The bit is used as the SoC low-power request. It is generated to tell TRNG that the clock to TRNG is going to stop running. This signal will be asserted no less than two clocks before TRNG clock is stopped, to allow TRNG to prepare for stop mode.0: No request; 1:Request

field.name: STOP_ACK
field.description: The bit is used as the SoC low-power acknowledge. TRNG will generate this single clock cycle pulse one clock cycle after STOP_REQ has been asserted.0:No Acknowledge; 1:Acknowledge

field.name: ENABLE
field.description: The bit is used to control the interface of TRNG. 0:Disable; 1: Enable

field.name: BUSY
field.description: The bit indicate that the TRNG is busy. This happens when the TRNG is busy sampling the entropy bits and has not issued an entropy valid signal.0: Free; 1: Busy; this bit should be zero after ENABLE(bit0 in this register) is set

field.name: HW_ERROR
field.description: The bit indicate that the TRNG has generated a hardware error. This could be due to a Frequency Count Fail, a run time or power on reset parameter misconfiguration, and /or a failure of one or more of the built in internal entropy quality tests. The cause of the error can be decoded by checking the bits of the STATUS register of TRNG.0:No Error; 1: Error

field.name: MCI_XOSC_EN

field.name: SOC_CIU_RDY_MASK
field.description: 1'b1:mask SOC_CIU_RDY, think its value is 1; 1'b0:unmask SOC_CIU_RDY, see its real value

register.description: Enable bit for le audio timer

field.name: CLR

field.name: STATUS

register.name: ELS_BOOT_ADDR
register.description: SW control for the ELS boot addr

field.name: PERR
field.description: parity error bit -When not masked by the PEM bit in the FCR register, the parity error indicator will appear in this bit.

field.name: TB
field.description: Data byte transmitted, leaset significant bit first

field.name: DMA_TIME
field.description: DMA Receive Request in event of a Time Out situation

field.name: EPS
field.description: Even Parity Select(EPS) - This bit is the even parity select bit. When EPS is a logic 0, an odd number of logic ones is transmitted or checked in the data word bits and the parity bit. When EPS is a logic 1, an even number of logic ones is transmitted or checked in the data word bits and parity bit

field.name: TXD_FORCE
field.description: Force TXD - This bit should always remain non-active unless running a deactivation process. In deactivation the I/O must be turned low before turning down the card's voltage

field.name: RXD
field.description: Reflects serail data from the I/O pad

field.name: EGTM
field.description: Extra Guard Time Moments: Number of total Guard Time moments

field.name: BGT
field.description: Block Guard TIME: Number of total Block Guard Time moments

field.name: TO
field.description: Time Out: Number of total Time Out moments

field.name: DIVISOR
field.description: Baud Divisor - Determines the number of USIM clock in between samples, forcing the total length of a bit to be DIVISOR*(FACTOR+1)*(USIM_CYCLE). The value zero if forbidden for DIVISOR.

field.name: FACTOR
field.description: Baud Factor - Determines the number of samples per bit. Number of samples would be (FACTOR+1). ISO standard demands minimum of 6 samples; therefore 5 is the minimum value of FACTOR bits

field.name: CWT
field.description: Character Waiting Time - Number of total Character Waiting Time moments

field.name: BWT
field.description: Block Waiting Time - Number of total Block Waiting Time moments

field.name: ACTIV
field.description: PKC active: ACTIV=1 signals that a calculation is in progress or about to start.

field.name: CARRY
field.description: Carry overflow flag: CARRY is set by the PKC at the end of a calculation in case; - an addition or multiplication with addition operation has been executed and an overflow in the most significant bit has occured.

field.name: ZERO
field.description: Zero result flag: ZERO is set by the PKC at the end of a calculation in case the result of the calculation is equal zero.

field.name: GOANY
field.description: Combined GO status flag: GOANY is set in case either PKC_CTRL.

field.name: LOCKED
field.description: Parameter set locked: Indicates if parameter set is locked due to a pending calculation start or can be overwritten.

field.name: RESET
field.description: PKC reset control bit: RESET=1 enforces the PKC's reset state during which a calculation cannot be started and by which any ongoing calculation process is stopped.

field.name: STOP
field.description: Freeze PKC calculation: STOP=1 freezes all PKC activity incl.

field.name: GOD1
field.description: Control bit to start direct operation using parameter set 1: If GOD1 is set PKC will start a direct / layer0 operation using parameter set 1 (PKC_MODE1, PKC_XYPTR1, PKC_ZRPTR1, PKC_LEN1).

field.name: GOD2
field.description: Control bit to start direct operation using parameter set 2: If GOD2 is set PKC will start a direct / layer0 operation using parameter set 2 (PKC_MODE2, PKC_XYPTR2, PKC_ZRPTR2, PKC_LEN2).

field.name: GOM1
field.description: Control bit to start MC pattern using parameter set 1: If GOM1 is set PKC will start a MC pattern / layer1 operation using parameter set 1 (PKC_MODE1, PKC_XYPTR1, PKC_ZRPTR1, PKC_LEN1).

field.name: GOM2
field.description: Control bit to start MC pattern using parameter set 2: If GOM2 is set PKC will start a MC pattern / layer1 operation using parameter set 2 (PKC_MODE2, PKC_XYPTR2, PKC_ZRPTR2, PKC_LEN2).

field.name: GOU
field.description: Control bit to start pipe operation: If GOU is set PKC will start the pipe / layer2 operation (parameter fetch & calculation) described in section 'PKC Universal Pointer Fetch Operation'.

field.name: GF2CONV
field.description: Convert to GF2 calculation modes: If GF2CONV is set operations are mapped to their GF(2) equivalent operation modes.

field.name: CLRCACHE

register.name: IENR
register.description: Pin Interrupt Level or Rising Edge Interrupt Enable

enumeratedValue.name: ENRL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable rising edge or level interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: ENRL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable rising edge or level interrupt

register.name: SIENR
register.description: Pin Interrupt Level or Rising Edge Interrupt Set

enumeratedValue.name: SETENRL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable rising edge or level interrupt

register.name: CIENR
register.description: Pin Interrupt Level (Rising Edge Interrupt) Clear

enumeratedValue.name: CENRL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Disable rising edge or level interrupt

register.name: IENF
register.description: Pin Interrupt Active Level or Falling Edge Interrupt Enable

enumeratedValue.name: ENAF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable falling edge interrupt or set active interrupt level LOW

enumeratedValue.name: ENAF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable falling edge interrupt enabled or set active interrupt level HIGH

register.name: SIENF
register.description: Pin Interrupt Active Level or Falling Edge Interrupt Set

enumeratedValue.name: SETENAF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Select HIGH-active interrupt or enable falling edge interrupt

register.name: CIENF
register.description: Pin Interrupt Active Level or Falling Edge Interrupt Clear

enumeratedValue.name: CENAF_1
enumeratedValue.description: LOW-active interrupt selected or falling edge interrupt disabled

enumeratedValue.name: RDET_0
enumeratedValue.description: Read 0- No rising edge has been detected on this pin since Reset or the last time a one was written to this bit, Write 0- no operation

enumeratedValue.name: RDET_1
enumeratedValue.description: Read 1- a rising edge has been detected since Reset or the last time a one was written to this bit, Write 1- clear rising edge detection for this pin

enumeratedValue.name: FDET_0
enumeratedValue.description: Read 0- No falling edge has been detected on this pin since Reset or the last time a one was written to this bit, Write 0- no operation

enumeratedValue.name: FDET_1
enumeratedValue.description: Read 1- a falling edge has been detected since Reset or the last time a one was written to this bit, Write 1- clear falling edge detection for this bit

enumeratedValue.name: PSTAT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Read 0- interrupt is not being requested for this pin, Write 0- no operation.

enumeratedValue.name: PSTAT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Read 1- interrupt is being requested for this pin, Write 1 (edge-sensitive)- clear rising- and falling-edge detection for this pin, Write 1 (level-sensitive)- switch the active level for this pin (in the IENF register).

register.name: PMCFG
register.description: Pattern Match Interrupt Bit Slice Configuration

field.name: PROD_ENDPTS0
field.description: Determines whether slice 0 is an endpoint.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_EFFECT
enumeratedValue.description: No effect. Slice 0 is not an endpoint.

enumeratedValue.name: ENDPOINT
enumeratedValue.description: Endpoint. Slice 0 is the endpoint of a product term (minterm). Pin interrupt 0 in the NVIC is raised if the minterm evaluates as true.

field.name: CFG0
field.description: Specifies the match contribution condition for bit slice 0.

enumeratedValue.name: STICKY_RISING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Sticky rising edge. Match occurs if a rising edge on the specified input has occurred since the last time the edge detection for this bit slice was cleared. This match condition is only cleared when the PMCFG or the PMSRC registers are written to.

enumeratedValue.name: STICKY_FALLING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Sticky falling edge. Match occurs if a falling edge on the specified input has occurred since the last time the edge detection for this bit slice was cleared. This match condition is only cleared when the PMCFG or the PMSRC registers are written to.

enumeratedValue.name: STICKY_RISING_FALLING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Sticky rising or falling edge. Match occurs if either a rising or falling edge on the specified input has occurred since the last time the edge detection for this bit slice was cleared. This match condition is only cleared when the PMCFG or the PMSRC registers are written to.

enumeratedValue.name: HIGH_LEVEL
enumeratedValue.description: High level. Match (for this bit slice) occurs when there is a high level on the input specified for this bit slice in the PMSRC register.

enumeratedValue.name: LOW_LEVEL
enumeratedValue.description: Low level. Match occurs when there is a low level on the specified input.

enumeratedValue.name: CONSTANT_ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Constant 0. This bit slice never contributes to a match (should be used to disable any unused bit slices).

enumeratedValue.name: EVENT
enumeratedValue.description: Event. Non-sticky rising or falling edge. Match occurs on an event when either a rising or falling edge is first detected on the specified input (this is a non-sticky version of value 0x3). This bit is cleared after 1 clock cycle.

field.name: CR0INT
field.description: Interrupt flag for capture channel 0 event

field.name: CR1INT
field.description: Interrupt flag for capture channel 1 event

field.name: CR2INT
field.description: Interrupt flag for capture channel 2 event

field.name: CR3INT
field.description: Interrupt flag for capture channel 3 event

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The Timer Counter and Prescale Counter are enabled. When the timer is enabled by an external trigger or globally enabled by the external global start enable register, the CEN bit will automatically be set to 1.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Allow input global_enable=1 action to take effect

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Allow input trigger_enable=1 action to take effect

field.name: CAP0RE
field.description: Rising edge of capture channel 0: a sequence of 0 then 1 causes CR0 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP0FE
field.description: Falling edge of capture channel 0: a sequence of 1 then 0 causes CR0 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP0I
field.description: Generate interrupt on channel 0 capture event: a CR0 load generates an interrupt.

field.name: CAP1RE
field.description: Rising edge of capture channel 1: a sequence of 0 then 1 causes CR1 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP1FE
field.description: Falling edge of capture channel 1: a sequence of 1 then 0 causes CR1 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP1I
field.description: Generate interrupt on channel 1 capture event: a CR1 load generates an interrupt.

field.name: CAP2RE
field.description: Rising edge of capture channel 2: a sequence of 0 then 1 causes CR2 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP2FE
field.description: Falling edge of capture channel 2: a sequence of 1 then 0 causes CR2 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP2I
field.description: Generate interrupt on channel 2 capture event: a CR2 load generates an interrupt.

field.name: CAP3RE
field.description: Rising edge of capture channel 3: a sequence of 0 then 1 causes CR3 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP3FE
field.description: Falling edge of capture channel 3: a sequence of 1 then 0 causes CR3 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP3I
field.description: Generate interrupt on channel 3 capture event: a CR3 load generates an interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: CLEAR
enumeratedValue.description: Clear. Clear the corresponding External Match bit/output to 0 (MAT0 pin is LOW if pinned out).

enumeratedValue.name: SET
enumeratedValue.description: Set. Set the corresponding External Match bit/output to 1 (MAT0 pin is HIGH if pinned out).

enumeratedValue.name: TOGGLE
enumeratedValue.description: Toggle. Toggle the corresponding External Match bit/output.

enumeratedValue.name: CLEAR
enumeratedValue.description: Clear. Clear the corresponding External Match bit/output to 0 (MAT1 pin is LOW if pinned out).

enumeratedValue.name: SET
enumeratedValue.description: Set. Set the corresponding External Match bit/output to 1 (MAT1 pin is HIGH if pinned out).

enumeratedValue.name: TOGGLE
enumeratedValue.description: Toggle. Toggle the corresponding External Match bit/output.

enumeratedValue.name: CLEAR
enumeratedValue.description: Clear. Clear the corresponding External Match bit/output to 0 (MAT2 pin is LOW if pinned out).

enumeratedValue.name: SET
enumeratedValue.description: Set. Set the corresponding External Match bit/output to 1 (MAT2 pin is HIGH if pinned out).

enumeratedValue.name: TOGGLE
enumeratedValue.description: Toggle. Toggle the corresponding External Match bit/output.

enumeratedValue.name: CLEAR
enumeratedValue.description: Clear. Clear the corresponding External Match bit/output to 0 (MAT3 pin is LOW if pinned out).

enumeratedValue.name: SET
enumeratedValue.description: Set. Set the corresponding External Match bit/output to 1 (MAT3 pin is HIGH if pinned out).

enumeratedValue.name: TOGGLE
enumeratedValue.description: Toggle. Toggle the corresponding External Match bit/output.

field.name: CTMODE
field.description: The Count Control Register (CTCR) is used to select between Timer and Counter mode, and in Counter mode to select the pin and edge(s) for counting.

field.name: ENCC
field.description: Setting this bit to 1 enables clearing of the timer and the prescaler when the capture-edge event specified in bits 7:5 occurs

enumeratedValue.name: CHANNEL_0_RISING
enumeratedValue.description: Channel 0 Rising Edge. Rising edge of the signal on capture channel 0 clears the timer (if bit 4 is set).

enumeratedValue.name: CHANNEL_0_FALLING
enumeratedValue.description: Channel 0 Falling Edge. Falling edge of the signal on capture channel 0 clears the timer (if bit 4 is set).

enumeratedValue.name: CHANNEL_1_RISING
enumeratedValue.description: Channel 1 Rising Edge. Rising edge of the signal on capture channel 1 clears the timer (if bit 4 is set).

enumeratedValue.name: CHANNEL_1_FALLING
enumeratedValue.description: Channel 1 Falling Edge. Falling edge of the signal on capture channel 1 clears the timer (if bit 4 is set).

enumeratedValue.name: CHANNEL_2_RISING
enumeratedValue.description: Channel 2 Rising Edge. Rising edge of the signal on capture channel 2 clears the timer (if bit 4 is set).

enumeratedValue.name: CHANNEL_2_FALLING
enumeratedValue.description: Channel 2 Falling Edge. Falling edge of the signal on capture channel 2 clears the timer (if bit 4 is set).

enumeratedValue.name: MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: Match. CTIMERn_MAT0 is controlled by EM0.

enumeratedValue.name: PWM
enumeratedValue.description: PWM. PWM mode is enabled for CTIMERn_MAT0.

enumeratedValue.name: MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: Match. CTIMERn_MAT01 is controlled by EM1.

enumeratedValue.name: PWM
enumeratedValue.description: PWM. PWM mode is enabled for CTIMERn_MAT1.

enumeratedValue.name: MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: Match. CTIMERn_MAT2 is controlled by EM2.

enumeratedValue.name: PWM
enumeratedValue.description: PWM. PWM mode is enabled for CTIMERn_MAT2.

field.name: PWMEN3
field.description: PWM mode enable for channel3. Note: It is recommended to use match channel 3 to set the PWM cycle.

enumeratedValue.name: MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: Match. CTIMERn_MAT3 is controlled by EM3.

enumeratedValue.name: PWM
enumeratedValue.description: PWM. PWM mode is enabled for CT132Bn_MAT3.

cluster.name: CHANNEL[%s]
cluster.description: Array of registers: CTRL, INTVAL, STAT, TIMER

field.name: LOAD
field.description: Determines how the timer interval value (IVALUE -1) is loaded into the TIMER n register.

field.name: VALUE
field.description: Holds the current timer value of the down-counter.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. TIMER n interrupt is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. TIMER n interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_PENDING_INTERRUPT
enumeratedValue.description: No pending interrupt. Writing a zero is equivalent to no operation.

field.name: RUN
field.description: Indicates the state of TIMER n . RUN bit is read-only.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE_STATE
enumeratedValue.description: Idle state. TIMER n has stopped.

field.name: INUSE
field.description: Channel-In-Use flag. Operating details depend on the operating mode bit (MODCFG.MULTITASK), and affects the use of the Idle Channel register (IDLE_CH).

enumeratedValue.name: NO
enumeratedValue.description: This timer channel is not in use.

enumeratedValue.name: YES
enumeratedValue.description: This timer channel is in use.

field.name: NOC
field.description: Number Of Channels: identifies the number of channels in this MRT. (Minus 1 encoded)

field.name: NOB
field.description: Number Of Bits: identifies the number of timer bits in this MRT. (24 bits on this device)

field.name: MULTITASK
field.description: Selects the operating mode for the INUSE flags and the IDLE_CH register.

enumeratedValue.name: HARDWARE_STATUS_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware status mode. In this mode, the INUSE(n) flags for all channels are reset.

field.name: CHAN
field.description: Idle channel. Reading the CHAN bits, returns the lowest idle timer channel. The number is positioned so that it can be used as an offset from the MRT base address, to access the registers for the allocated channel. If all timer channels are running, then CHAN = 0xF.

field.name: GFLAG0
field.description: Monitors the interrupt flag of TIMER0.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_PENDING_INTERRUPT
enumeratedValue.description: No pending interrupt. Writing a zero is equivalent to no operation.

enumeratedValue.name: PENDING_INTERRUPT
enumeratedValue.description: Pending interrupt. The interrupt is pending because TIMER0 has reached the end of the time interval. If the INTEN bit in the CONTROL0 register is also set to 1, then the interrupt for timer channel 0 and the global interrupt are generated. Writing a 1 to GFLAG0 bit clears the interrupt request.

field.name: GFLAG1
field.description: Monitors the interrupt flag of TIMER1, and acts similarly to channel 0.

field.name: GFLAG2
field.description: Monitors the interrupt flag of TIMER2, and acts similarly to channel 0.

field.name: GFLAG3
field.description: Monitors the interrupt flag of TIMER3, and acts similarly to channel 0.

enumeratedValue.name: CYCLE_DONE
enumeratedValue.description: Process complete. Measurement cycle is complete. The results are ready in the RESULT field.

enumeratedValue.name: IN_PROGRESS
enumeratedValue.description: In Progress. Measurement cycle is in progress.

enumeratedValue.name: FREQ_ME_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Frequency Measurement Mode. FREQMECTRL works in a Frequency Measurement mode. Once the measurement starts (real count start is aligned at rising edge arrival on reference clock), the target counter increments by the target clock until the reference counter running by the reference clock reaches the count end point selected by REF_SCALE.

enumeratedValue.name: PULSE_ME_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Pulse Width Measurement mode. FREQMECTRL works in a Pulse Width Measurement mode, measuring the high or low period of reference clock input selected by PULSE_POL. The target counter starts incrementing by the target clock once a corresponding trigger edge (rising edge for high period measurement and falling edge for low period) occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: HIGH_PERIOD
enumeratedValue.description: High Period. High period of reference clock is measured in Pulse Width Measurement mode triggered by the rising edge on the reference clock input.

enumeratedValue.name: LOW_PERIOD
enumeratedValue.description: Low Period. Low period of reference clock is measured in Pulse Width Measurement mode triggered by the falling edge on the reference clock input.

enumeratedValue.name: FORCE_TERMINATE
enumeratedValue.description: Force Terminate. Forces the termination of any measurement cycle currently in progress and resets RESULT or just resets RESULT if in idle.

enumeratedValue.name: INITIATE_A_FREQME_CYCLE
enumeratedValue.description: Initiates Measurement Cycle. Initiates frequency or pulse width measurement process. Hardware clears the MEASURE_IN_PROGRESS bit when the measurement cycle completes. A new measurement starts if there is an active measurement in progress.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_IN_RESET
enumeratedValue.description: Not in reset. The RTC is not held in reset. This bit must be cleared prior to configuring or initiating any operation of the RTC.

enumeratedValue.name: IN_RESET
enumeratedValue.description: In reset. The RTC is held in reset. All register bits within the RTC will be forced to their reset value except the OFD bit. This bit must be cleared before writing to any register in the RTC - including writes to set any of the other bits within this register. Do not attempt to write to any bits of this register at the same time that the reset bit is being cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: RUN
enumeratedValue.description: Run. The RTC oscillator is running properly. Writing a 0 has no effect.

enumeratedValue.name: FAIL
enumeratedValue.description: Fail. RTC oscillator fail detected. Clear this flag after the following power-up. Writing a 1 clears this bit.

field.name: ALARM1HZ
field.description: RTC 1 Hz timer alarm flag status.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: No match. No match has occurred on the 1 Hz RTC timer. Writing a 0 has no effect.

enumeratedValue.name: MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: Match. A match condition has occurred on the 1 Hz RTC timer. This flag generates an RTC alarm interrupt request RTC_ALARM which can also wake up the part from any low power mode. Writing a 1 clears this bit.

field.name: WAKE1KHZ
field.description: RTC 1 kHz timer wake-up flag status.

enumeratedValue.name: RUN
enumeratedValue.description: Run. The RTC 1 kHz timer is running. Writing a 0 has no effect.

enumeratedValue.name: TIME_OUT
enumeratedValue.description: Time-out. The 1 kHz high-resolution/wake-up timer has timed out. This flag generates an RTC wake-up interrupt request RTC-WAKE which can also wake up the part from any low power mode. Writing a 1 clears this bit.

field.name: ALARMDPD_EN
field.description: RTC 1 Hz timer alarm enable for Deep power-down.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Disable. A match on the 1 Hz RTC timer will not bring the part out of Deep power-down mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enable. A match on the 1 Hz RTC timer bring the part out of Deep power-down mode.

field.name: WAKEDPD_EN
field.description: RTC 1 kHz timer wake-up enable for Deep power-down.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Disable. A match on the 1 kHz RTC timer will not bring the part out of Deep power-down mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enable. A match on the 1 kHz RTC timer bring the part out of Deep power-down mode.

field.name: RTC1KHZ_EN
field.description: RTC 1 kHz clock enable. This bit can be set to 0 to conserve power if the 1 kHz timer is not used. This bit has no effect when the RTC is disabled (bit 7 of this register is 0).

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Disable. A match on the 1 kHz RTC timer will not bring the part out of Deep power-down mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enable. The 1 kHz RTC timer is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Disable. The RTC 1 Hz and 1 kHz clocks are shut down and the RTC operation is disabled. This bit should be 0 when writing to load a value in the RTC counter register.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enable. The 1 Hz RTC clock is running and RTC operation is enabled. This bit must be set to initiate operation of the RTC. The first clock to the RTC counter occurs 1 s after this bit is set. To also enable the high-resolution, 1 kHz clock, set bit 6 in this register.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The RTC oscillator is enabled. This bit must be cleared in order for the RTC module to function

enumeratedValue.name: SHUT_OFF
enumeratedValue.description: The RTC oscillator is shut-off to reserve power consumption. RTC operation is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: The RTC Oscillator operates normally as a crystal oscillator with the crystal connected between the RTC_XTLALIN and RTC_XTALOUT pins.

enumeratedValue.name: BYPASS
enumeratedValue.description: The RTC oscillator is in bypass mode. In this mode a clock can be directly input into the RTC_XTALIN pin.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The sub-second counter (if implemented) is disabled. This bit is cleared by a system-level POR or BOD reset as well as a by the RTC_ENA bit (bit 7 in this register). On modules not equipped with a sub-second counter, this bit will always read-back as a '0'

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The 32 KHz sub-second counter is enabled (if implemented). Counting will commence on the start of the first one-second interval after this bit is set. Note: This bit can only be set after the RTC_ENA bit (bit 7) has been set by a previous write operation. Note: The RTC sub-second counter must be re-enabled whenever the chip exits deep_powerdown mode.

field.name: MATVAL
field.description: Contains the match value against which the 1 Hz RTC timer will be compared to set the alarm flag RTC_ALARM and generate an alarm interrupt/wake-up if enabled.

field.name: VAL
field.description: A read reflects the current value of the main, 1 Hz RTC timer. A write loads a new initial value into the timer. The RTC counter will count up continuously at a 1 Hz rate once the RTC Software Reset is removed (by clearing bit 0 of the CTRL register). Only write to this register when the RTC_EN bit in the RTC CTRL Register is 0. The counter increments one second after the RTC_EN bit is set.

field.name: VAL
field.description: A read reflects the current value of the high-resolution/wake-up timer. A write pre-loads a start count value into the wake-up timer and initializes a count-down sequence. Do not write to this register while counting is in progress.

field.name: RTC_SUBSEC
field.description: A read reflects the current value of the 32Khz sub-second counter. This counter will be cleared whenever the SUBSEC_ENA bit in the RTC_CONTROL register is low. Up-counting at a 32 KHz rate commences at the start of the next one-second interval after the SUBSEC_ENA bit is set. This counter must be re-enabled after exiting deep_powerdown mode or after the main RTC module has been disabled and re-enabled. On modules not equipped with a sub-second counter, this register will read-back as all zeroes.

cluster.name: CHANNEL[%s]
cluster.description: Array of registers: CFG, CTLSTAT, XFERCFG

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware triggering not used for channel.

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE_LOW_FALLING
enumeratedValue.description: Active low - falling edge. Hardware trigger is active low or falling edge triggered, based on TRIGTYPE.

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE_HIGH_RISING
enumeratedValue.description: Active high - rising edge. Hardware trigger is active high or rising edge triggered, based on TRIGTYPE.

enumeratedValue.name: EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Edge. Hardware trigger is edge triggered. Transfers will be initiated and completed, as specified for a single trigger.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. Destination burst wrapping is not enabled for this DMA channel.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. Destination burst wrapping is enabled for this DMA channel.

field.name: CHPRIORITY
field.description: Priority of channel when multiple DMA requests are pending.

register.name: CTLSTAT
register.description: Control and status register for DMA channel

field.name: VALIDPENDING
field.description: Valid pending flag for this channel.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_TRIGGERED
enumeratedValue.description: Not triggered. The trigger for this DMA channel is not set. DMA operations will not be carried out.

enumeratedValue.name: TRIGGERED
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered. The trigger for this DMA channel is set. DMA operations will be carried out.

register.name: XFERCFG
register.description: Transfer configuration register for DMA channel

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The channels' control structure should not be reloaded when the current descriptor is exhausted.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The channels' control structure should be reloaded when the current descriptor is exhausted.

field.name: SETINTA
field.description: Set Interrupt flag A for channel.

enumeratedValue.name: SET
enumeratedValue.description: Set. The INTA flag for this channel will be set when the current descriptor is exhausted.

field.name: SETINTB
field.description: Set Interrupt flag B for channel.

enumeratedValue.name: SET
enumeratedValue.description: Set. The INTB flag for this channel will be set when the current descriptor is exhausted.

field.name: WIDTH
field.description: Transfer width used for this DMA channel.

field.name: XFERCOUNT
field.description: Total number of transfers to be performed, minus 1 encoded.

register.name: PSELID
register.description: Peripheral Select and Flexcomm module ID

enumeratedValue.name: UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: Peripheral select can be changed by software.

enumeratedValue.name: LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: Peripheral select is locked and cannot be changed until this Flexcomm module or the entire device is reset.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_PRESENT
enumeratedValue.description: This Flexcomm module does not include the USART function.

enumeratedValue.name: PRESENT
enumeratedValue.description: This Flexcomm module includes the USART function.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_PRESENT
enumeratedValue.description: This Flexcomm module does not include the SPI function.

enumeratedValue.name: PRESENT
enumeratedValue.description: This Flexcomm module includes the SPI function.

field.name: ID
field.description: Module identifier for the selected function

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The I2C Master function is disabled. When disabled, the Master configuration settings are not changed, but the Master function is internally reset.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The I2C Master function is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The I2C slave function is disabled. When disabled, the Slave configuration settings are not changed, but the Slave function is internally reset.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The I2C slave function is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The I2C Monitor function is disabled. When disabled, the Monitor function configuration settings are not changed, but the Monitor function is internally reset.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The I2C Monitor function is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The time-out function is disabled. When disabled, the time-out function is internally reset.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The time-out function is enabled. Both types of time-out flags will be generated and will cause interrupts if those flags are enabled. Typically, only one time-out flag will be used in a system.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The Monitor function will not perform clock stretching. Software or DMA may not always be able to read data provided by the Monitor function before it (the data) is overwritten. This mode can be used when non-invasive monitoring is critical.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The Monitor function will perform clock stretching, to ensure that the software or DMA can read all incoming data supplied by the Monitor function.

enumeratedValue.name: IN_PROGRESS
enumeratedValue.description: In progress. Communication is in progress and the Master function is busy and cannot currently accept a command.

enumeratedValue.name: PENDING
enumeratedValue.description: Pending. The Master function needs software service or is in the idle state. If the master is not in the idle state, then the master is waiting to receive or transmit data, or is waiting for the NACK bit.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: Idle. The Master function is available to be used for a new transaction.

enumeratedValue.name: RECEIVE_READY
enumeratedValue.description: Receive ready. Received data is available (in Master Receiver mode). Address plus Read was previously sent and Acknowledged by a slave.

enumeratedValue.name: TRANSMIT_READY
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit ready. Data can be transmitted (in Master Transmitter mode). Address plus Write was previously sent and Acknowledged by a slave.

enumeratedValue.name: NACK_DATA
enumeratedValue.description: NACK Data. Slave NACKed transmitted data.

enumeratedValue.name: ARBITRATION_LOSS
enumeratedValue.description: Arbitration loss. The Master function has experienced an Arbitration Loss. At this point, the Master function has already stopped driving the bus and has gone into an idle state. Software can respond by doing nothing, or by sending a Start (to attempt to gain control of the bus when the bus next becomes idle).

enumeratedValue.name: ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: The Master function has experienced a Start/Stop Error. A Start or Stop was detected at a time when Start or Stop is not allowed by the I2C specification. The Master interface has stopped driving the bus and gone into an idle state; no action is required. A request for a Start could be made, or software could attempt to make sure that the bus has not stalled.

enumeratedValue.name: IN_PROGRESS
enumeratedValue.description: In progress. The Slave function does not currently need software service.

enumeratedValue.name: PENDING
enumeratedValue.description: Pending. The Slave function needs software service. Information about what is needed is in the Slave state field (SLVSTATE).

enumeratedValue.name: SLAVE_ADDRESS
enumeratedValue.description: Slave address. Address plus R/W received. At least one of the 4 slave addresses has been matched by hardware.

enumeratedValue.name: SLAVE_RECEIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Slave receive. Received data is available (in Slave Receiver mode).

enumeratedValue.name: SLAVE_TRANSMIT
enumeratedValue.description: Slave transmit. Data can be transmitted (in Slave Transmitter mode).

enumeratedValue.name: STRETCHING
enumeratedValue.description: Stretching. The slave function is currently stretching the I2C bus clock. Deep-Sleepmode cannot be entered at this time.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_STRETCHING
enumeratedValue.description: Not stretching. The slave function is not currently stretching the I2C bus clock. Deep-sleep mode can be entered at this time.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_SELECTED
enumeratedValue.description: Not selected. The Slave function is not currently selected.

enumeratedValue.name: SELECTED
enumeratedValue.description: Selected. The Slave function is currently selected.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DESELECTED
enumeratedValue.description: Not deselected. The Slave function has not become deselected. This does not mean that the Slave is currently selected. That information is in the SLVSEL flag.

enumeratedValue.name: DESELECTED
enumeratedValue.description: Deselected. The Slave function has become deselected. This is specifically caused by the SLVSEL flag changing from 1 to 0. See SLVSEL for details about when that event occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_DATA
enumeratedValue.description: No data. The Monitor function does not currently have data available.

enumeratedValue.name: DATA_WAITING
enumeratedValue.description: Data waiting. The Monitor function has data waiting to be read.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_OVERRUN
enumeratedValue.description: No overrun. Monitor data has not overrun.

enumeratedValue.name: OVERRUN
enumeratedValue.description: Overrun. A Monitor data overrun has occurred. An overrun can only happen when Monitor clock stretching not enabled via the CFG[MONCLKSTR] bit. Writing 1 to MONOV bit clears the MONOV flag.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Inactive. The Monitor function considers the I2C bus to be inactive.

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Active. The Monitor function considers the I2C bus to be active.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: Not idle. The I2C bus is not idle, or MONIDLE flag has been cleared by software.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: Idle. The I2C bus has gone idle at least once, since the last time MONIDLE flag was cleared by software.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_TIMEOUT
enumeratedValue.description: No time-out. I2C bus events have not caused a time-out.

enumeratedValue.name: EVEN_TIMEOUT
enumeratedValue.description: Event time-out. The time between I2C bus events has been longer than the time specified by the TIMEOUT register.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_TIMEOUT
enumeratedValue.description: No time-out. SCL low time has not caused a time-out.

enumeratedValue.name: TIMEOUT
enumeratedValue.description: Time-out. SCL low time has caused a time-out.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The MstPending interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: TIMEOUT16
enumeratedValue.description: A time-out will occur after 16 counts of the I2C function clock.

enumeratedValue.name: TIMEOUT32

enumeratedValue.name: TIMEOUT65K
enumeratedValue.description: A time-out will occur after 65,536 counts of the I2C function clock.

enumeratedValue.description: FCLK is used directly by the I2C.

enumeratedValue.name: FCLKDIV2
enumeratedValue.description: FCLK is divided by 2 before being used by the I2C.

enumeratedValue.name: FCLKDIV65K

enumeratedValue.name: CONTINUE
enumeratedValue.description: Continue. Informs the Master function to continue to the next operation. This action must done after writing transmit data, reading received data, or any other housekeeping related to the next bus operation.

enumeratedValue.name: START
enumeratedValue.description: Start. A Start will be generated on the I2C bus at the next allowed time.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP
enumeratedValue.description: Stop. A Stop will be generated on the I2C bus at the next allowed time, preceded by a NACK to the slave if the master is receiving data from the slave (in Master Receiver mode).

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disable. No DMA requests are generated for master operation.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enable. A DMA request is generated for I2C master data operations. When this I2C master is generating Acknowledge bits in Master Receiver mode, the acknowledge is generated automatically.

enumeratedValue.name: MSTSCLLOW_2CLOCKS
enumeratedValue.description: 2 clocks. Minimum SCL low time is 2 clocks of the I2C clock pre-divider.

enumeratedValue.name: MSTSCLLOW_3CLOCKS
enumeratedValue.description: 3 clocks. Minimum SCL low time is 3 clocks of the I2C clock pre-divider.

enumeratedValue.name: MSTSCLLOW_4CLOCKS
enumeratedValue.description: 4 clocks. Minimum SCL low time is 4 clocks of the I2C clock pre-divider.

enumeratedValue.name: MSTSCLLOW_5CLOCKS

enumeratedValue.name: MSTSCLLOW_6CLOCKS
enumeratedValue.description: 6 clocks. Minimum SCL low time is 6 clocks of the I2C clock pre-divider.

enumeratedValue.name: MSTSCLLOW_7CLOCKS
enumeratedValue.description: 7 clocks. Minimum SCL low time is 7 clocks of the I2C clock pre-divider.

enumeratedValue.name: MSTSCLLOW_8CLOCKS
enumeratedValue.description: 8 clocks. Minimum SCL low time is 8 clocks of the I2C clock pre-divider.

enumeratedValue.name: MSTSCLLOW_9CLOCKS
enumeratedValue.description: 9 clocks. Minimum SCL low time is 9 clocks of the I2C clock pre-divider.

enumeratedValue.name: MSTSCLHIGH_2CLOCKS
enumeratedValue.description: 2 clocks. Minimum SCL high time is 2 clocks of the I2C clock pre-divider.

enumeratedValue.name: MSTSCLHIGH_3CLOCKS
enumeratedValue.description: 3 clocks. Minimum SCL high time is 3 clocks of the I2C clock pre-divider .

enumeratedValue.name: MSTSCLHIGH_4CLOCKS
enumeratedValue.description: 4 clocks. Minimum SCL high time is 4 clocks of the I2C clock pre-divider.

enumeratedValue.name: MSTSCLHIGH_5CLOCKS

enumeratedValue.name: CONTINUE
enumeratedValue.description: Continue. Informs the Slave function to continue to the next operation, by clearing the STAT[SLVPENDING] flag. This must be done after writing transmit data, reading received data, or any other housekeeping related to the next bus operation. Automatic Operation has different requirements. SLVCONTINUE should not be set unless SLVPENDING = 1.

enumeratedValue.name: NACK
enumeratedValue.description: NACK. Causes the Slave function to NACK the master when the slave is receiving data from the master (in Slave Receiver mode).

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. No DMA requests are issued for Slave mode operation.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. DMA requests are issued for I2C slave data transmission and reception.

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: Normal, non-automatic operation. If AUTONACK = 0, then a SlvPending interrupt is generated when a matching address is received. If AUTONACK = 1, then received addresses are NACKed (ignored).

enumeratedValue.name: AUTOMATIC_ACK
enumeratedValue.description: A header with matching SLVADR0 and matching direction as set by AUTOMATCHREAD will be ACKed immediately, allowing the master to move on to the data bytes. If the address matches SLVADR0, but the direction does not match AUTOMATCHREAD, then the behavior will depend on the SLVADR0[AUTONACK] bit: if AUTONACK is set, then it will be Nacked; if AUTONACK is clear, then a SlvPending interrupt is generated.

enumeratedValue.name: I2C_WRITE
enumeratedValue.description: In Automatic Mode, the expected next operation is an I2C write.

enumeratedValue.name: I2C_READ
enumeratedValue.description: In Automatic Mode, the expected next operation is an I2C read.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. Slave Address n is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Ignored. Slave Address n is ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: Normal operation, matching I2C addresses are not ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: AUTOMATIC
enumeratedValue.description: Automatic-only mode. All incoming addresses are ignored (NACKed), unless AUTOACK is set, and the address matches SLVADRn, and AUTOMATCHREAD matches the direction.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. Slave Address n is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Ignored. Slave Address n is ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: Normal operation, matching I2C addresses are not ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: AUTOMATIC
enumeratedValue.description: Automatic-only mode. All incoming addresses are ignored (NACKed), unless AUTOACK is set, and the address matches SLVADRn, and AUTOMATCHREAD matches the direction.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Ignored. Slave Address n is ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL

enumeratedValue.name: AUTOMATIC
enumeratedValue.description: Automatic-only mode. All incoming addresses are ignored (NACKed), unless AUTOACK is set, and the address matches SLVADRn, and AUTOMATCHREAD matches the direction.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. Slave Address n is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Ignored. Slave Address n is ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: Normal operation, matching I2C addresses are not ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: AUTOMATIC
enumeratedValue.description: Automatic-only mode. All incoming addresses are ignored (NACKed), unless AUTOACK is set, and the address matches SLVADRn, and AUTOMATCHREAD matches the direction.

enumeratedValue.name: MASK
enumeratedValue.description: Mask. The SLVQUAL0 field is used as a logical mask for matching address 0.

enumeratedValue.name: EXTEND
enumeratedValue.description: Extend. The SLVQUAL0 field is used to extend address 0 matching in a range of addresses.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_START_DETECTED
enumeratedValue.description: No start detected. The Monitor function has not detected a Start event on the I2C bus.

enumeratedValue.name: START_DETECTED
enumeratedValue.description: Start detected. The Monitor function has detected a Start event on the I2C bus.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DETECTED
enumeratedValue.description: No repeated start detected. The Monitor function has not detected a Repeated Start event on the I2C bus.

enumeratedValue.name: DETECTED
enumeratedValue.description: Repeated start detected. The Monitor function has detected a Repeated Start event on the I2C bus.

enumeratedValue.name: ACKNOWLEDGED
enumeratedValue.description: Acknowledged. The data currently being provided by the Monitor function was acknowledged by at least one master or slave receiver.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED
enumeratedValue.description: Not acknowledged. The data currently being provided by the Monitor function was not acknowledged by any receiver.

enumeratedValue.name: PAUSED
enumeratedValue.description: Data Paused. A data pause has been requested and is now in force.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The receive FIFO is not enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED

field.name: EMPTYTX
field.description: Empty command for the transmit FIFO. When a 1 is written to this bit, the TX FIFO is emptied.

field.name: EMPTYRX
field.description: Empty command for the receive FIFO. When a 1 is written to this bit, the RX FIFO is emptied.

enumeratedValue.name: DO_NOT_POP
enumeratedValue.description: Debug reads of the FIFO do not pop the FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: POP
enumeratedValue.description: A debug read causes the FIFO to pop.

enumeratedValue.name: EMPTY
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit FIFO is empty; however, the peripheral may still be processing the last piece of data.

enumeratedValue.name: FULL
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit FIFO is full, and another write would cause an overflow

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_FULL
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit FIFO is not full, so more data can be written

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_EMPTY
enumeratedValue.description: Receive FIFO is not empty, so data can be read.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: RX FIFO has timed out, based on the timeout configuration in the FIFORXTIMEOUTCFG register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit FIFO level does not generate a FIFO level trigger.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: An trigger generates if the transmit FIFO level reaches the value specified by the TXLVL field in this register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Receive FIFO level does not generate a FIFO level trigger.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: An trigger generates if the receive FIFO level reaches the value specified by the RXLVL.

enumeratedValue.name: EMPTY
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger when the TX FIFO becomes empty.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE_ENTRY
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger when the TX FIFO level decreases to one entry.

enumeratedValue.name: FIFTEEN_ENTRIES
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger when the TX FIFO level decreases to 15 entries (is no longer full).

enumeratedValue.name: ONE_ENTRY
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger when the RX FIFO has received 1 entry (the FIFO is no longer empty).

enumeratedValue.name: TWO_ENTRIES
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger when the RX FIFO has received 2 entries.

enumeratedValue.name: SIXTEEN_ENTRIES
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger when the RX FIFO has received 16 entries (the FIFO has become full).

field.description: The most recent CRC sum can be read through this register with selected bit order and 1's complement post-processes.

field.name: CRC_WR_DATA
field.description: Data written to this register will be taken to perform CRC calculation with selected bit order and 1's complement pre-process. Any write size 8, 16 or 32-bit are allowed and accept back-to-back transactions.

cluster.name: CHANNEL[%s]
cluster.description: Array of registers: DC_CTRL, DIVHFCLK, FIFO_CTRL, FIFO_DATA, FIFO_STATUS, GAINSHIFT, OSR, PHY_CTRL, PREAC2FSCOEF, PREAC4FSCOEF

enumeratedValue.name: COMP0
enumeratedValue.description: Compensation = 0. This is the recommended setting.

enumeratedValue.name: COMP0
enumeratedValue.description: Compensation = 0. This is the recommended setting.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO is not enabled. Enabling a DMIC channel with the FIFO disabled could be useful while data is being streamed to the I2S, or in order to avoid a filter settling delay when a channel is re-enabled after a period when the data was not needed.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO is enabled. The FIFO must be enabled in order for the CPU or DMA to read data from the DMIC via the FIFODATA register.

enumeratedValue.name: RESET
enumeratedValue.description: Reset the FIFO. This must be cleared before resuming operation.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO level interrupts are not enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: DMA requests based on FIFO level are enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ONEENTRY
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger when the FIFO has received one entry (is no longer empty).

enumeratedValue.name: TWOENTRIES
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger when the FIFO has received two entries.

enumeratedValue.name: ENTRIES15
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger when the FIFO has received 15 entries.

enumeratedValue.name: ENTRIES16
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger when the FIFO has received 16 entries (has become full).

field.name: PHY_FALL
field.description: Capture DMIC on Falling edge (0 means on rising)

enumeratedValue.name: RISING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Capture PDM_DATA on the rising edge of PDM_CLK.

enumeratedValue.name: FALLING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Capture PDM_DATA on the falling edge of PDM_CLK.

field.name: PHY_HALF
field.description: Use Half rate sampling (ie Clock to dmic is sent at half the speed than the decimator is providing)

enumeratedValue.name: STANDARD
enumeratedValue.description: Standard half rate sampling. The clock to the DMIC is sent at the same rate as the decimator is providing.

enumeratedValue.name: HALF_RATE
enumeratedValue.description: Use half rate sampling. The clock to the DMIC is sent at half the rate that the decimator is providing.

enumeratedValue.name: DO_NOT_SATURATE
enumeratedValue.description: Do not Saturate. Results roll over if out range and do not saturate.

enumeratedValue.name: SATURATE
enumeratedValue.description: Saturate. If the result overflows, it saturates at 0xFFFF for positive overflow and 0x8000 for negative overflow.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The top byte of the FIFODATA register is always 0.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The top byte of the FIFODATA register is sign extended.

enumeratedValue.name: USE_1FS
enumeratedValue.description: Use 1 FS output for PCM data.

enumeratedValue.name: USE_2FS
enumeratedValue.description: Use 2 FS output for PCM data.

field.name: HPFS
field.description: The HPFS field chooses the High Pass filter in first part of HWVAD.

enumeratedValue.name: HIGH_PASS_1750HZ
enumeratedValue.description: HIGH_PASS_1750HZ. High pass filter with -3dB cut-off at 1750 Hz.

enumeratedValue.name: HIGH_PASS_215HZ
enumeratedValue.description: HIGH_PASS_215HZ. High pass filter with -3dB cut-off at 215 Hz.

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: Normal operation, waiting for HWVAD trigger event (stage 0).

enumeratedValue.name: RESET
enumeratedValue.description: Reset internal interrupt flag by writing a '1' (stage 1) pulse.

field.name: SPI_MD
field.description: SPI mode. Only valid when lcdic_md = 1'd0.

field.name: RST_START
field.description: LCD reset start signal. Single pulse.

field.name: RST_SEQ_NUM
field.description: Reset sequence pulse number. 3'd0: 1 pulse; 3'd7: 8 pulse.

field.name: RST_SEQ
field.description: Reset sequence. LCD_RST will send rst_seq[0] onto lcd_reset first, and then followed by rst_seq[1] until rst_seq_num is reached.

field.name: RST_WIDTH
field.description: Width of each reset pulse. Unit is T(timer_base0). T(reset pulse) = T(timer_base0)*(rst_width+1).

field.name: TCSW
field.description: CS wait time. Minimum CS inactive pulse width. T(csw)=T(lcdic_clk)*tcsw.

field.name: TCSS
field.description: CS setup time. Minimum CS setup time before WR/RD. T(css)=T(lcdic_clk)*tcss.

field.name: TCSH
field.description: CS hold time. Minimum CS hold time after WR/RD. T(csh)=T(lcdic_clk)*tcsh.

field.name: TDCS
field.description: DC setupt time. Minimum DC setup time before WR/RD/CS. T(dcs)=T(lcdic_clk)*tdcs.

field.name: TDCH
field.description: DC hold time. Minimum DC hold time after WR/RD/CS. T(dch)=T(lcdic_clk)*tdch.

field.name: TWDS
field.description: Write data setup time. Minimum write data setup time before WR active. T(wds)=T(lcdic_clk)*twds.

field.name: TWDH
field.description: Write data hold time. Minimum write data setup time after WR active. T(wdh)=T(lcdic_clk)*twdh.

field.name: TWAW
field.description: Minmum write enable active pulse width. T(waw)=T(lcdic_clk)*twaw.

field.name: TWIW
field.description: Minmum write enable inactive pulse width. T(wiw)=T(lcdic_clk)*twiw.

field.name: TRAW
field.description: Minmum read enable active pulse width. T(raw)=T(lcdic_clk)*traw.

field.name: TRIW
field.description: Minmum read enable inactive pulse width. T(riw)=T(lcdic_clk)*triw.

field.name: TTEW
field.description: Tearing effect signal synchronization wait time. Unit is T(timer_base1). T(tew)=T(timer_base1)*ttew.

field.name: TE_TO
field.description: Tearing effect timeout time. Unit is T(timer_base1). T(te_to)=T(timer_base1)*te_to. 6'd0 means no te_to check.

field.name: CMD_SHORT_TO
field.description: Command short timeout. Unit is T(timer_base0). T(cmd_short_to)=T(timer_base0)*cmd_short_to. 4'd0 means no cmd_short_to check.

field.name: CMD_LONG_TO
field.description: Command long timeout. Unit is T(timer_base1). T(cmd_long_to)=T(timer_base1)*cmd_long_to. 16'd0 means no cmd_long_to check.

field.name: TB_CNT
field.description: Transmission byte counter which indicates how many TB has been successfully transmitted.

field.name: TRX_CMD
field.description: TRX command which is under processing.

field.name: RXCLKSRC
field.description: Sample Clock source selection for Flash Reading

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Dummy Read strobe generated by FlexSPI Controller and loopback internally.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Dummy Read strobe generated by FlexSPI Controller and loopback from DQS pad.

enumeratedValue.name: val3
enumeratedValue.description: Flash provided Read strobe and input from DQS pad

field.name: ARDFEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus Read Access to IP RX FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO should be read by IP Bus. AHB Bus read access to IP RX FIFO memory space will get bus error response.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO should be read by AHB Bus. IP Bus read access to IP RX FIFO memory space will always return data zero but no bus error response.

field.name: ATDFEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus Write Access to IP TX FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO should be written by IP Bus. AHB Bus write access to IP TX FIFO memory space will get bus error response.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO should be written by AHB Bus. IP Bus write access to IP TX FIFO memory space will be ignored but no bus error response.

field.name: HSEN
field.description: Half Speed Serial Flash access Enable.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Doze mode support disabled. AHB clock and serial clock will not be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Doze mode support enabled. AHB clock and serial clock will be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.

field.name: COMBINATIONEN
field.description: This bit is to support Flash Octal mode access by combining Port A and B Data pins (A_DATA[3:0] and B_DATA[3:0]), when Port A and Port B are of 4 bit data width.

field.name: SCKFREERUNEN
field.description: This bit is used to force SCLK output free-running. For FPGA applications, external device may use SCLK as reference clock to its internal PLL.

field.name: LEARNEN
field.description: This bit is used to enable/disable data learning feature. When data learning is disabled, the sampling clock phase 0 is always used for RX data sampling even if LEARN instruction is correctly executed.

field.name: IPGRANTWAIT
field.description: Timeout wait cycle for IP command grant.

field.name: AHBGRANTWAIT
field.description: Timeout wait cycle for AHB command grant.

field.name: SEQWAIT
field.description: Command Sequence Execution will timeout and abort after SEQWAIT * 1024 Serial Root Clock cycles. When sequence execution timeout occurs, there will be an interrupt generated (INTR[SEQTIMEOUT]) if this interrupt is enabled (INTEN[SEQTIMEOUTEN] is set 0x1) and AHB command is ignored by arbitrator.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will not be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.

field.name: CLRLEARNPHASE
field.description: The sampling clock phase selection will be reset to phase 0 when this bit is written with 0x1. This bit will be auto-cleared immediately.

field.name: SAMEDEVICEEN
field.description: All external devices are same devices (both in types and size) for A1/A2/B1/B2.

enumeratedValue.name: individual_parallel
enumeratedValue.description: In Individual mode, FLSHA1CRx/FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2 separately. Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: FLSHA1CR0/FLSHA1CR1/FLSHA1CR2 register settings will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2. FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx will be ignored.

field.name: SCKBDIFFOPT
field.description: B_SCLK pad can be used as A_SCLK differential clock output (inverted clock to A_SCLK). In this case, port B flash access is not available. After changing the value of this field, MCR0[SWRESET] should be set.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: B_SCLK pad is used as port B SCLK clock output. Port B flash access is available.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: B_SCLK pad is used as port A SCLK inverted clock output (Differential clock to A_SCLK). Port B flash access is not available.

field.name: RXCLKSRC_B
field.description: Sample Clock source selection for Flash Reading

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Dummy Read strobe generated by FlexSPI Controller and loopback internally.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Dummy Read strobe generated by FlexSPI Controller and loopback from DQS pad.

enumeratedValue.name: val3
enumeratedValue.description: Flash provided Read strobe and input from DQS pad

field.name: RX_CLK_SRC_DIFF

field.name: RESUMEWAIT
field.description: Wait cycle (in AHB clock cycle) for idle state before suspended command sequence resumed.

field.name: CLRAHBRXBUF
field.description: Clear the status/pointers of AHB RX Buffer. Auto-cleared.

field.name: CLRAHBTXBUF
field.description: Clear the status/pointers of AHB TX Buffer. Auto-cleared.

field.name: CACHABLEEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus cachable read access support.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. When there is AHB bus cachable read access, FlexSPI will not check whether it hit AHB TX Buffer.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. When there is AHB bus cachable read access, FlexSPI will check whether it hit AHB TX Buffer first.

field.name: BUFFERABLEEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus bufferable write access support.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. For all AHB write access (no matter bufferable or non-bufferable ), FlexSPI will return AHB Bus ready after all data is transmitted to External device and AHB command finished.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. For AHB bufferable write access, FlexSPI will return AHB Bus ready when the AHB command is granted by arbitrator and will not wait for AHB command finished.

field.name: READADDROPT
field.description: AHB Read Address option bit. This option bit is intend to remove AHB burst start address alignment limitation.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: There is AHB read burst start address alignment limitation when flash is accessed in flash is word-addressable.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: There is no AHB read burst start address alignment limitation. FlexSPI will fetch more data than AHB burst required to meet the alignment requirement.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Suspended AHB read prefetch will start to resume when AHB is IDLE

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Suspended AHB read prefetch will not resume once it is aborted

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: AHB read size will be decided by other register setting like PREFETCH_EN

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: AHB read size to up size to 8 bytes aligned, no prefetching

field.name: ALIGNMENT
field.description: Decides all AHB read/write boundary. All access cross the boundary will be divided into smaller sub accesses.

field.name: CSINTERVAL
field.description: This field is used to set the minimum interval between flash device Chip selection deassertion and flash device Chip selection assertion. If external flash has a limitation on the interval between command sequences, this field should be set accordingly. If there is no limitation, set this field with value 0x0.

field.name: ARDSEQID
field.description: Sequence Index for AHB Read triggered Command in LUT.

field.name: ARDSEQNUM
field.description: Sequence Number for AHB Read triggered Command in LUT.

field.name: AWRSEQID
field.description: Sequence Index for AHB Write triggered Command.

field.name: AWRSEQNUM
field.description: Sequence Number for AHB Write triggered Command.

field.name: AWRWAIT
field.description: For certain devices (such as FPGA), it need some time to write data into internal memory after the command sequences finished on FlexSPI interface. If another Read command sequence comes before previous programming finished internally, the read data may be wrong. This field is used to hold AHB Bus ready for AHB write access to wait the programming finished in external device. Then there will be no AHB read command triggered before the programming finished in external device. The Wait cycle between AHB triggered command sequences finished on FlexSPI interface and AHB return Bus ready: AWRWAIT * AWRWAITUNIT

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 2 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 8 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: val2
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 32 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: val3
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 128 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: val4
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 512 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: val5
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 2048 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: val6
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 8192 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: val7
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 32768 ahb clock cycle

field.name: CLRINSTRPTR
field.description: Clear the instruction pointer which is internally saved pointer by JMP_ON_CS.

field.name: WMOPT1
field.description: Write mask option bit 1. This option bit could be used to remove AHB write burst start address alignment limitation.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: DQS pin will be used as Write Mask when writing to external device. There is no limitation on AHB write burst start address alignment when flash is accessed in individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: DQS pin will not be used as Write Mask when writing to external device. There is limitation on AHB write burst start address alignment when flash is accessed in individual mode.

field.name: WMOPT2
field.description: Write mask option bit 2. When using AP memory, This option bit could be used to remove AHB write burst minimal length limitation. When using this bit, WMOPT1 should also be set.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: DQS pin will be used as Write Mask when writing to external device. There is no limitation on AHB write burst length when flash is accessed in individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: DQS pin will not be used as Write Mask when writing to external device. There is limitation on AHB write burst length when flash is accessed in individual mode, the minimal write burst length should be 4.

field.name: WMENA
field.description: Write mask enable bit for flash device on port A. When write mask function is needed for memory device on port A, this bit must be set.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is disabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will not be driven when writing to external device.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is enabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be driven by FlexSPI as write mask output when writing to external device.

field.name: WMENB
field.description: Write mask enable bit for flash device on port B. When write mask function is needed for memory device on port B, this bit must be set.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is disabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will not be driven when writing to external device.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is enabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be driven by FlexSPI as write mask output when writing to external device.

field.name: PAR_WM
field.description: Enable APMEM 16 bit write mask function, bit 9 for A1-B1 pair, bit 10 for A2-B2 pair.

field.name: PAR_ADDR_ADJ_DIS
field.description: Disable the address shift logic for lower density of 16 bit PSRAM.

field.name: SFAR
field.description: Serial Flash Address for IP command.

field.name: IDATSZ
field.description: Flash Read/Program Data Size (in Bytes) for IP command.

field.name: ISEQID
field.description: Sequence Index in LUT for IP command.

field.name: ISEQNUM
field.description: Sequence Number for IP command: ISEQNUM+1.

field.name: IPBLKALLAHB
field.description: If this bit is 1, handshake will block all AHB. Otherwise only ahb hit gcm region will be blocked.

field.name: TRG
field.description: Setting this bit will trigger an IP Command.

field.name: CLRIPRXF

field.name: RXDMAEN
field.description: IP RX FIFO reading by DMA enabled.

enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO would be read by processor.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO would be read by DMA.

field.name: CLRIPTXF
field.description: Clear all valid data entries in IP TX FIFO.

field.name: TXDMAEN
field.description: IP TX FIFO filling by DMA enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO would be filled by processor.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO would be filled by DMA.

field.name: SLVDLYTARGET
field.description: The delay target for slave delay line is: ((SLVDLYTARGET+1) * 1/32 * clock cycle of reference clock (serial root clock). If serial root clock is >= 100 MHz, DLLEN set to 0x1, OVRDEN set to =0x0, then SLVDLYTARGET setting of 0xF is recommended.

field.name: OVRDEN
field.description: Slave clock delay line delay cell number selection override enable.

field.name: OVRDVAL
field.description: Slave clock delay line delay cell number selection override value.

field.name: SEQIDLE
field.description: This status bit indicates the state machine in SEQ_CTL is idle and there is command sequence executing on FlexSPI interface.

field.name: ARBIDLE
field.description: This status bit indicates the state machine in ARB_CTL is busy and there is command sequence granted by arbitrator and not finished yet on FlexSPI interface. When ARB_CTL state (ARBIDLE=0x1) is idle, there will be no transaction on FlexSPI interface also (SEQIDLE=0x1). So this bit should be polled to wait for FlexSPI controller become idle instead of SEQIDLE.

field.name: ARBCMDSRC
field.description: This status field indicates the trigger source of current command sequence granted by arbitrator. This field value is meaningless when ARB_CTL is not busy (STS0[ARBIDLE]=0x1).

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by AHB read command (triggered by AHB read).

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by AHB write command (triggered by AHB Write).

enumeratedValue.name: val2
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by IP command (triggered by setting register bit IPCMD.TRG).

field.name: DATALEARNPHASEA
field.description: Indicate the sampling clock phase selection on Port A after Data Learning.

field.name: DATALEARNPHASEB
field.description: Indicate the sampling clock phase selection on Port B after Data Learning.

field.name: AHBCMDERRID
field.description: Indicates the sequence index when an AHB command error is detected. This field will be cleared when INTR[AHBCMDERR] is write-1-clear(w1c).

field.name: AHBCMDERRCODE
field.description: Indicates the Error Code when AHB command Error detected. This field will be cleared when INTR[AHBCMDERR] is write-1-clear(w1c).

enumeratedValue.name: val2
enumeratedValue.description: AHB Write command with JMP_ON_CS instruction used in the sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: val3
enumeratedValue.description: There is unknown instruction opcode in the sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: val4
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction DUMMY_SDR/DUMMY_RWDS_SDR used in DDR sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: val5
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction DUMMY_DDR/DUMMY_RWDS_DDR used in SDR sequence.

field.name: IPCMDERRID
field.description: Indicates the sequence Index when IP command error detected.

field.name: IPCMDERRCODE
field.description: Indicates the Error Code when IP command Error detected. This field will be cleared when INTR[IPCMDERR] is write-1-clear(w1c).

enumeratedValue.name: val2
enumeratedValue.description: IP command with JMP_ON_CS instruction used in the sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: val3
enumeratedValue.description: There is unknown instruction opcode in the sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: val4
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction DUMMY_SDR/DUMMY_RWDS_SDR used in DDR sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: val5
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction DUMMY_DDR/DUMMY_RWDS_DDR used in SDR sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: val6

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The MAC stops transmission of data frames after the current transmission is complete.
